challengers.writeup: Melat Kiros is a newly elected member of Congress with no voting record. Her public positions are strongly anti-interventionist: she supports a full arms embargo on Israel, including defensive weapons, and opposes continued U.S. military aid to the state, citing genocide in Gaza. She has also opposed U.S. military action against Iran and supports reclaiming Congressional war powers from the president. Her commitment to these views is evidenced by her being fired from a law firm for criticizing the chilling effect on lawyers who criticize the Israeli government and by surviving a primary campaign featuring $1.3 million in attacks from Super PACs. She refuses corporate PAC money and advocates for a 10% reduction in Pentagon spending to weaken the military-industrial complex. However, as a candidate who has not yet cast a vote, she has not met the floor for a sitting member, which requires at least one real breaking vote against her own party leadership.
challengers.bottom_line: Does not count because she has no legislative record of breaking votes to prove her reliability under pressure.
